question: What will be the percentage change in the CBOE 10-year Treasury yield index (^TNX) (^TNX on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-21 to the close on 2026-10-06?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-10-06 / close on 2026-09-21 - 1), using daily closes of ^TNX on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-10-06, the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't get the official Sept 21 close, but one secondary site puts it at about 4.96%. The 10-year was sitting near 5%, its highest in about 19 years, as the window opened.

## 1. Resolution source
- The Yahoo Finance ^TNX history page wouldn't load (the proxy refused the connection), so I could not read the official Sept 21 close.
- 2026-09-21: Dealplexus, a secondary site, shows the 10-year at open 4.95%, high 4.98%, low 4.95%, close 4.96%. It is the only source I found for that date. [dealplexus](https://www.dealplexus.com/markets/us-10-year-treasury-yield)
- ^TNX on Yahoo is quoted as the yield in percent (about 4.96). The question uses a ratio, so a 10 bp move is about 2.0%.
- I found no reliable close for 2026-09-22 so far.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. About 11 trading days remain between the Sept 21 close and the Oct 6 close.
- The starting level is about 4.96%, just under the 5% mark.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-20: A report citing Treasury par yields says the 10-year closed Sept 18 at 5.01%, up 5 bp on the week. It closed at or above 5% on three sessions that week. The 2-year rose 13 bp on the week and the 30-year was about 5.34%. The headline pointed to a $183B note auction test ahead. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/10-year-treasury-yield-closes-at-5-01-before-183-billion-auction-test/)
- 2026-09-17: Yields moved lower the day after the Fed began a hiking cycle, with the 10-year near 4.93-4.94%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/17/treasury-yields-move-lower-after-fed-kicks-off-hiking-cycle.html)
- 2026-09-16: The Fed hiked 25 bp to 3.75-4.00%. It was the first hike since July 2023, and secondary coverage reports the vote as 12-0. Chair Warsh stressed inflation risks, and the 10-year climbed back to about 5%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/treasury-yield-bond-market-fed-decision.html)
- 2026-09-15: BMO said the one-month correlation between WTI oil and the 10-year yield had reached 0.96. Oil is the main driver. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/15/oil-us-treasurys-stocks-pressure.html)
- 2026-09-14: The 10-year touched 5.014% intraday, its highest since 2007, then reversed to about 4.99%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/10-year-us-treasury-is-closing-in-on-5percent.html)
- 2026-09-09: The 10-year hit its highest since 2023 despite Treasury Secretary Bessent's $6B bond buyback plan. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/09/treasury-yields-oil-inflation.html)
- 2026-09-08: The 10-year briefly went back above 4.8% as oil rose. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/08/us-treasury-yields-bonds.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent path (Treasury par yields, via the ts2.tech report): Sept 14 4.97, Sept 15 5.00, Sept 16 5.01, Sept 17 4.94, Sept 18 5.01, then about 4.96 on Sept 21.
- The trend has been up: about 4.8% on Sept 8 to about 5.0% by mid-September, roughly +4% in two weeks. In a 52-week window dealplexus gives a low of 3.96%; its high figure is left out because it may include data after Sept 22.
- Typical variation is my own estimate, not sourced. The 10-year usually moves about 5-8 bp a day. Over about 11 trading days that gives a standard deviation of roughly 18-25 bp, or about ±3.5-5% of a 4.96% level. Recent volatility looks above average because of oil-driven inflation fears and a Fed hiking cycle.
- Moves of more than ±10% (about 50 bp) in two weeks are rare outside crisis periods.

## 5. Other forecasts
- A Manifold market on 10-year yield thresholds exists, but the page wouldn't load, so I have no price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-the-us-10year-treasury-yield-c)
- Octagon AI has pages on where the 10-year yield will be in late September, but they are low quality and I didn't use them. [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/financials/interest-rates/how-high-will-the-10y-us-treasury-yield-get-by-sep-30-2026.md)
- I found no Kalshi or Polymarket price for this window.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Week of 2026-09-21: about $183B of 2-, 5- and 7-year note auctions. That total matches the usual $69B/$70B/$44B sizes, but I did not confirm the September sizes. Poor demand could push yields higher. [Nasdaq (July example)](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/two-year-five-year-note-auctions-attract-mixed-demand)
- Late September (usual timing, not confirmed): the third estimate of Q2 GDP and the August PCE inflation report.
- 2026-09-30: end of the fiscal year, when government funding runs out. I did not check whether a shutdown is a risk this year.
- 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02 (usual timing): ISM manufacturing on Oct 1, and the September jobs report expected Oct 2.
- Ongoing: oil prices and Iran headlines, with oil and the 10-year moving closely together, plus speeches from Fed officials.
- The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for late October, after this window.

I didn't use any material dated after 2026-09-22.
